content.comment_body: Hello everyone, does anyone know if it’s possible to change the background color of the programming screen in [product_name] [version_no] from white back to the familiar grey that we’re used to? I’ve checked related discussions but haven’t found a solution that works. Maybe it’s not possible, but I figured I’d ask. Many thanks in advance, [user_name].
If none of the three color backlight options is chosen, the standard grey remains available.
Hi, go to: Tools > Options > Colors and adjust settings as needed.

Thank you, I’ll try that soon. I have another question. I’m attempting to use potentiometers to set counter and timer values, but in [product_name] [version_no] when I click on the timer/counter, I can’t locate where to select the external reference. In [version_no] it was simple, you would just click the reference button and choose the block number. Am I missing something or have things changed? Thanks again for your help, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing how to customize the background color of the programming interface in [product_name] [version_no], with some uncertainty due to changes from previous versions. There is also confusion regarding the method for configuring external references with counters and timers, as the process seems less straightforward than before.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like an easy option to restore the grey background and expects the settings for external references on timers/counters to be as accessible and intuitive as in earlier editions.
